issue_context.title: App crash when opening properties
issue_context.body:
**Explain the bug**
When I try opening properties of a drive it will crash instantly. When doing it for folders it will open but crash when I press cancel (why is that there in the first place) the properties.

**Expected behaviour**
Open properties of the folder or drive

**Logfile**
[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/6326666/debug.log)
[debug_fulltrust.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/6326667/debug_fulltrust.log)

**System Information**
 - OS Version: Windows 10 20H2 19042.928
 - App version: v1.5.13
